_doc: Pilot portrait prompts (design/world/depth/art/README.md), v4 2026-11-25: imagine first, then describe specifically (user). imagined = the writer's picture of one concrete moment, kept for review and not sent; subject = the precise description that is sent. sex m/f; age = apparent age; dress = a dress.json key or null; memorial = a dead person's memorial portrait; also_medium = also paint a medium-quality copy for comparison.

people.imagined: Deep night in the ice hall over the buried vent. She has just played her three qin pieces alone, as every night, and stood up. The jade vessel is in her hands because she always takes it from the stand when she rises. The frost from her breath hangs in the air. She has heard someone come in, the viewer, and has turned her eyes without turning her head.
people.subject: The moment: late at night in a hall of blue ice, she has just risen from her qin and turned only her eyes toward the viewer. Face: a narrow oval face with high cheekbones and a long straight nose; skin pale as porcelain with a faint blue tint at the temples; thin straight dark brows, dark despite her white hair; pale grey irises with darker rims, the lashes frosted white at the tips; a small closed mouth with pale rose lips; one fine line between the brows, the only sign of age. Hair: pure white, waist-long and straight, parted in the middle; the top half drawn back into a flat coil held by a single plain white-jade hairpin shaped like an icicle, the rest falling loose behind her shoulders. Clothing: an inner robe of white silk whose crossed collar is edged with a thin pale-blue band; over it a heavy white silk outer robe, unembroidered, with wide sleeves; at the waist a narrow sash of silver-white frost silk glittering with rime. No jewellery. Hands and object: long fingers with short nails cradle, at breast height, a small jade wine vessel the size of a pear, pale celadon green, frosted white on the outside, with a soft blue glow showing through the jade where the ice inside it sits. A thin plume of mist leaves her lips. Background: blurred pale-blue ice pillars and, low behind her, the dark shape of a qin on a low table. Light: cold blue-white light from the upper left; the vessel's faint glow lights her chin from below. Expression: utterly still, attentive, not unkind.

people.imagined: Dawn at the valley hall's door. He has finished the night's teaching of the boy, the robe folded away, and is leaving for the plateau road. The wind off the plateau is the only thing in the valley that answers him, and it is pulling at the long sleeve. Someone has called his name and he has turned his head, not his body.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a windy threshold, he has turned to leave and looks back over his right shoulder at the viewer; his body is three-quarters turned away. Face: long, lean and wind-burnt brown; deep crow's-feet; a straight narrow nose with a small bump from an old break; thin lips set in patience; a short iron-grey beard trimmed close along the jaw, no moustache; dark brown eyes narrowed against the wind, unreadable. Hair: iron grey, short for a cultivator, gathered at the crown into a small tight knot bound with a strip of grey cloth. Body: tall and lean, square shoulders, upright. Clothing: a long robe of fine undyed grey cloth, matte and well pressed, with a plain black inner collar and a flat charcoal sash. The robe's LEFT sleeve is twice as long as the right: it hangs far past his left hand, almost to the knee, and streams sideways in the wind, while the right sleeve ends neatly at the wrist; this long sleeve is clearly visible. Sword: slung across his back, a long straight sword in a plain black lacquered scabbard, its black-wrapped hilt with a simple round iron guard rising above his right shoulder. Background: blurred grey dawn sky over a windswept rocky plateau, one small hawk far off. Light: pale cold morning light from the upper left. Expression: humble, quiet, very dangerous.

people.imagined: The spring auction at Vật Hoa Thị, evening, lanterns going up. A merchant has just made a bid she finds funny and she laughs out loud, fan up, while she is already working out what his laugh back will cost him. She has one child's name more to leave off her list tonight.
people.subject: The moment: at an evening market auction, she laughs out loud at someone's bid, head tipped a little back, while her eyes stay fixed and calculating on the viewer. Face: broad and round with wide cheekbones; sun-browned skin with freckles across the nose; full lips with a little red on them; strong straight dark brows; dark brown eyes; a small mole beside the left corner of her mouth; laugh lines. Hair: thick and black, coiled into a high double loop at the crown, held by a carved maple-wood comb with a pressed red maple leaf tucked behind it; two loose strands at the ears. Clothing: an outer robe of fine dusk-violet silk with a wide crossed collar; under it a deep maple-red robe showing at the collar and the cuffs; sleeves pushed back over strong brown forearms; a broad sash of dull gold brocade. Hands and object: her right hand holds an open folding fan of eight polished red-brown maple ribs with thin cream paper between them, lifted just below her chin; on each rib a small painted picture in gold: a fish, a horse, a boat, a bell, a pine, a goose, a lamp, a wave. Thin gold rings on her middle and ring fingers. Background: blurred warm lanterns and awnings of an evening market. Light: warm sunset light from the upper left; a faint amber glow like late sun on clay around her fingers. Expression: laughing, charming, cold underneath.

people.imagined: Dusk on a poor road outside a starving town. He has stopped at a doorway where an old woman is dying and is waiting, politely, to be asked in. The lamp is lit because he is working. He would never ring the bell; he holds it like a relic.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a poor road, he waits politely at a dark doorway, the lamp lit because he is working. Face: long and thin with hollow cheeks; papery pale skin with faint age spots; heavy-lidded eyes with pale brown irises; a small polite closed-mouth smile; thin grey brows; a sparse grey beard combed into a neat point. Hair: grey and thinning, combed back immaculately into a small topknot held by a plain wooden pin. Body: stooped, narrow shoulders, head carried a little forward. Clothing: a long, scrupulously clean pedlar's coat of good dark grey wool with a stand-up collar fastened at the throat by five knotted cloth buttons; a plain black inner collar; clean cuffs. Lamp: a pole across his left shoulder; from its end hangs a squat black bronze lantern pierced with nine small round holes in three rows of three, and in each hole a tiny pale white flame leans toward the viewer as if breathing. Bell: in his right hand, held against his chest, a small bronze hand bell with a visible dark crack down one side, its clapper wound tight with red thread. Background: a blurred dusk road and a dark doorway. Light: dim grey dusk; the nine little flames throw a cold grey-green light up onto his face. Expression: courteous, patient, deeply unsettling.

people.imagined: First light in the high loft of the pavilion. The birds are waking on her; the drongo, always the first awake, has stepped onto her gauntlet. She is pleased with herself this morning: nine red-crested chicks hatched in the hidden loft, and nobody knows yet.
people.subject: The moment: first light in a high bird loft; she holds up her left forearm, where a black bird has just stepped onto her gauntlet, and smiles at the viewer. Face: narrow and angular, tanned; sharp cheekbones; a pointed chin with a small white crescent scar from a beak; quick dark eyes; a smile that lifts the corners of her mouth but leaves her eyes cold. Hair: thick dark brown-black, pinned up at the back in a loose untidy knot with two long blue tail feathers pushed through it, wisps escaping. Birds: on her right shoulder a small, slender sky-blue bird the size of a thrush, with a short pointed crest, a black eye-stripe, and one long thin ribbon tail hanging down over her arm to the elbow. On her raised left forearm a glossy black fork-tailed drongo with a single red eye, looking at the viewer. Clothing: a fitted jungle-green tunic of fine cloth with a high collar, its edge embroidered with small brown leaves; over her shoulders a short capelet sewn from hundreds of moulted feathers, russet, brown and blue, overlapping like scales; a dark brown leather gauntlet on the left forearm; a carved bone whistle on a leather cord at her throat. Background: blurred jungle leaves and wooden perches. Light: warm green-gold dappled light from the upper left; ember-red glints at the feather tips. Expression: friendly, pleased with herself, calculating.

people.imagined: Just before dawn in the bamboo grove of Lôi Trúc Lâm. She has sat up all night watching for whoever cuts the rite poles short, and nobody came. She is cold and tired and will not go to bed. The mist is the only rain her rite made last night.
people.subject: The moment: just before dawn in a bamboo grove, after a whole night keeping watch; she stands very still, tired and unwilling to go in. Face: very small and sun-darkened, deep wrinkles around the eyes and mouth; sharp cheekbones; a narrow pointed chin; thin lips pressed together; dark eyes red-rimmed from the sleepless night but steady and kind; grey brows. Hair: thin grey hair parted in the middle and pulled into a small low bun; damp wisps at the temples. Body: tiny and frail, a thin neck, narrow sloping shoulders, a slight stoop. Clothing: a plain grey robe of good hemp-silk, clean, with a crossed collar, tied with a black cord; over it a black oiled rain cloak tied at the throat; a wide rice-straw hat hanging at her back on its cord. Hands: small, folded over her chest, right over left; on the left wrist a clear pale band of lighter skin where a bell cord used to be. Background: tall pale-green bamboo stems fading into grey mist. Light: cool grey dawn light from the upper left; mist beads on her cloak; a faint green sheen in the mist. Expression: tired, stubborn, watchful.

people.imagined: The Đới reeling house at Tang Điền, the year she began to teach them. Steam everywhere. She is showing a girl how to draw the first thread, and is not looking at anyone; she is singing under her breath. Five hundred years later this is how the family remembers her, on a faded scroll in the hall.
people.subject: The moment: in a steamy reeling house, she draws the first thread from a cocoon, absorbed, perhaps singing under her breath. Face: round and gentle with smooth skin; a small nose; a soft full mouth; eyes cast down on the thread; a small old burn scar the size of a thumbprint at her left temple, pale and shiny. Hair: black, bound under a cream cotton head cloth tied at the back of the neck. Clothing: a neat cotton robe of a merchant's house, faded ochre, the crossed collar trimmed in soft rust; sleeves tied back above the elbows with a cord. Hands and objects: her left hand holds a shallow white porcelain bowl of steaming water with three pale cocoons floating in it; her right hand is raised, and a single fine silk thread rises from a cocoon to between her finger and thumb, catching the light. Background: blurred wooden reeling frames in the steam. Light: warm soft light from the upper left through steam. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like a silk scroll, with darkened edges and fine cracks. Expression: patient, calm, absorbed.

people.imagined: Night on the Tùng Đào bank of the Ngư Ca, the last time anyone of his own saw him: he is coiling the line he will take across. He is the kind of man who coils rope while he waits, without knowing he does it. Behind him, the dark is the dark of the river cellar he does not know he is going to.
people.subject: The moment: at night by a river, he coils a rope while he waits, without looking at his hands. Face: square and windburnt with a heavy brow; a small notch in the left eyebrow from an old cut; wary narrowed dark eyes; a strong jaw shadowed with a few days of black stubble; a closed, patient mouth. Hair: black, tied in a working topknot with a short pine twig pushed through it. Hands and object: big hands, both palms crossed by pale rope-burn scars in clear lines, coiling a coarse hemp rope into a neat loop held at his chest. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of fine undyed pine-bark linen, well tailored, crossed at the chest; a needle-green silk sash; a short padded vest of the same linen over the robe; sleeves bound at the wrist with cord for climbing. A faint green-brown sheen of Wood qi along the rope. Background: deep darkness, wet black stone glistening and a thin trickle of water running down it. Light: one low warm light from the lower left, as from a lamp set down. Expression: patient, wary, keeping his words.

people.imagined: The Night Rain Market's door at Thu Trì, in rain. He has been counting the people going in all night and someone has just looked at him a moment too long, the viewer. He is not sure if he has been noticed counting. The lip makes him look as if he is smirking, which makes it worse.
people.subject: The moment: at a market door at night in the rain, he has just been looked at and stares back, unsure whether he has been caught counting. Face, most important: he has a cleft-lip scar, clearly visible: a pale raised scar runs straight up from the middle of his upper lip to his left nostril, and that side of the lip is notched and lifted, so his mouth looks like a permanent crooked smirk. A lanky, plain, homely seventeen-year-old: a long face, a slightly flattened nose, ears that stick out, uneven dark eyebrows, small quick suspicious eyes. Hair: black, hacked short and sticking up, wet with rain. Clothing: a plain blue-grey cultivator's robe of decent cloth, new and still a little stiff on his thin frame; a black cord belt; an oiled dark rain cape over his shoulders, beaded with raindrops. Hands: one hand at his chest, a tally cord of knotted string looped around the fingers. Background: a blurred wooden doorway and a red paper lantern glowing in the rain. Light: damp amber lantern light from one side, cool blue night on the other. Expression: wary, paranoid, ready to bolt.

people.imagined: A wine shop in Đà Linh Trấn at noon, dust in the air. A caravan master has come to hire him and he is grinning at the man too long, enjoying that the man is afraid. The sabre is on his back because he never takes it off. The taint has made his teeth go brown like old iron.
people.subject: The moment: in a dusty desert wine shop, he grins at the viewer a moment too long, enjoying their fear. Face, most important: a wide open grin that shows his teeth, and his teeth are stained dark brown, like betel-stained or rusted iron, clearly not white. A lean, hawkish, sand-scoured face; skin cracked and darkened by sun and wind; deep creases beside the mouth; flat amused eyes that do not blink enough; a thin drooping moustache and a wisp of beard at the chin. Hair: long, black and dusty, tied back carelessly at the nape. Clothing: a well-made riding robe of good dust-coloured cloth with a high collar; under it a dark rust-red robe at the throat; a broad leather belt with round brass fittings; leather bracers on the forearms. Weapon: a curved sabre in a black scabbard slung across his back, the hilt over his right shoulder, a dull red glow like a coal along the edge where it shows. A faint sick red haze hangs about him. Background: blurred dusty sunlight through a wine shop's doorway. Light: hot dusty light from the upper left. Expression: cruel, faithless, at ease.
